given: A connected Python service references a third-party library that is not vendored/installed in the clone; the warm host-side LSP is up.
when: 'Proxy, find all references to Session.commit' is asked, spanning both in-repo call sites and calls into the uninstalled dependency.
then: In-repo references resolve via the warm LSP tagged 'resolved'; references into the uninstalled dep are labeled 'external-references-not-resolved' (a distinct label, never dropped, never conflated with the grep lower-bound); on an LSP timeout it falls back to grep tagged 'lower-bound' and restarts a hung server.
